notes: New: make a step only when you click (with the Click Helper). Moving the mouse, hovering and scrolling now record as smooth video instead of extra steps.
Movement between clicks plays as one continuous recording, including movement before your first click.
Deleting a step hands its movement to the step before, so the video never jumps.
Trimmed clips stop exactly where you set them.
Player buttons no longer cover hotspots in the top-right corner.
